Essay:
We all have different personalities and different traits in us. Do you think people's personalities are influenced by others or they choose their own traits? People are being influenced by other people like family, friends, and lover. Whether with the type of friends they have, how their family treats them, or how they see the society around them. When I was in middle school, my friends were different from high school now because of how different middle school and high school are. Like the maturity level or how they talk is different. That also changes you on how you are depends on the society. Not a single person was born to get to choose their traits. They response to the action of what the society is doing like trending conditions, or what other people do that makes the person do it as well.

First, the type of friends people have changes how they are. If we have friends that are supportive and caring. Then we might be one of the luckiest to have decent friends and this might turn us into a supportive person just like their friends. On the other side, if we have no friends at all, we might turn into a cold person and lonely. Everyone acts differently when they are with friends and family. When we are with their family, we act differently than with our friends like we have to be more polite and respectful to them. From how their family treats us and telling us of what to do and not do. Compare to if we were with friends, we would be more disrespectful to our friends because friends don't care, but on the good side it is more joyful to be with friends than family.

Second, how people see the society around them. Not just how other people treat us makes us be a different person, it's also how we see other people around us. For an example, trend. Sometimes, we try to fit in the society around us so we can be the same as them. Mostly, we follow people who we think that are cool to hang with. For another example, this famous app called "Tiktok", we download Tiktok because it's trending in 2020, there's a lot of cool people in the app. Let's if Tiktok wasn't famous would you download Tiktok? Probably not. We dress like how other people dress, we eat with forks like how most Americans do because of the culture. If our family takes us fishing a lot when we were little then we might like fishing. If everyone in the neighborhood likes playing soccer, then we are considering ourselves to like soccer. This shows that how we are because of how see the outside not just family.

Last, How our lover treats us can change our personality. Some people might change themselves because of how our lover wants us to be like. So if they don't change, they can argue then breakup/divorce. Some people are so obsessed with their lover to the point to change themselves so they and their partner can have the equivalent with each other. Not only that they have to change for them, it's also how they treat. There have been saying if you had a bad break up, you might change your personality to be colder or better than how you were in the relationship. When I broke up with my girlfriend, I changed myself too. So I can be a better person and not have to have the same personality.

In conclusion, our character formed by influences beyond our control. The reasons are because how our friends and family treat us, how we see the society and the trend, and how our lover can change us. You cannot choose your own character, you can only see how other people are and you have to be like them. Even if you are living in the woods like Mowgli, you are acting differently from other people that are living in the city. So, people's traits come from the society they are in and they cannot choose their own traits.

I agree that you shouldn't aim high, because when you aim high you never have a staring point to your own process, if you aim high it could ruin your work ethic and how you see yourself, and lastly you can make muiltiple mistakes and correct it and make it perfect work, compared to aiming and doing horrible work and falling back down to the bottom.

When you aim low you have way more time to gain information, practice on your work, and have a good idea on what you want to do. So aiming low gives you the advantage of failing and not giving up on what you want to become. Most people are always told to "aim high" the ones that are told to aim high will never be able to handle failure because they never aimed low first and then worked their way to the top, that is how setting your aim to high can make you fall short in life.

Aiming high, and having a high expectation can really hurt your work ethic, Why you ask? because once you aim high and never practice on your work thats how you fail, the way you work will not be the same compared to a person who aimed low and is making his or her way to the top. For example Delonte West was a NBA basketball player he was really good, until he began to use drugs once he did that he was kicked out of the NBA and is now currently poor. The only way to start in any journey or process that you do is to start from the bottom meaning aim low and you'll achieve your mark. Aiming high can not benefit how you were able to make it to where you are now. That is true Michaelangelo was right about aiming high and falling short. So you must start low first figure out your plan, then begin to improvise and get ideas on what you want to do, and begin your process, that is exactly how you achieve your mark

In conclusion, i highly agree on what Michaelangelo said "The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high and falling short; but in setting our aim too low, and achieving our mark" that statement was true, Aiming and srting low first is how ideas come in and you are able to see what you are working and you show people what you can do until you reach your highest peak, instead of aiming high and failing and not knowing what to do now cause you failed. Many people think that if you set your goal low, it is easier to achieve. That is true,but, no goal is achievable if you don't put a minimum effort into achieving your goal. It does'nt matter if you goal is high or low, if you put the right amount of work in, you will achieve your goal.

Micheangelo said, "The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high and falling short; but in setting our aim too low, and achieving our mark" setting your goal high and failing while trying is better than going for a low goal and achieving it because you aren't learning anything from that low goal expierience, on the other hand, if you set a high goal and fail in the attempt to achieve that goal, you gain expierience from that.

I agree with Michelangelo's statement, this is very true, in many cases, people tend to have low standard goals, which they can attain easily. Only a few people tend to set high standard goals. Many famous people had to fail at first to achieve their goal like Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. Both of them started from humble begginings. Lionel Messi was rejected by a lot of clubs in Argentina because of his low height caused by a disease. Until he finally foud the right club in Spain where they would play for his treatment and have him live there. Now he's argueably the best soccer player on the world and he is living the best life he could because of the amount of effort he put into his dream and the learning expierience he obtained when he got rejected by all of those clubs. Other famous people like Steve Jobs, Bill Gates and many other succesfull people failed while trying to get to the top but at the end we all know they reached their mark.

Now you can see how setting a high goal can be better in the long run. These goals are not easy to reach, but, if you put dedication into that goal, you will acomplish it. You will fall trying to reach the top, not just once, but, a lot of times. But all of that makes achieving your goal worth it because of the high standard of your goal. Setting a low goal will not satisfy you and you will not go anywhere since you want to keep it safe and you're too scared to fail. Doing this will not help you in life because life is all about reaching those high marks and failing while trying.

There is always a counterargument, and I get it, people try not to risk themselves and fail while trying, so they instead prefer to keep it safe and achieve their low standard goals. There is always a good thing about that, there are always small things you want to obtain like the newest cellphone, the newest gaming console, anything in those standards. It satisfies you to some extent when you obtain those things; however, like these small things don't help you in the long run because these are things that you will have to throw away eventually, unlike the things you achieve when you set high standard goals.

In conclusion, what Michelangelo said was true because learning from your failures is better than not learning anything at all when you have small goals. It is something that not a lot of people take into consideration because people want their things easy and they don't want to put that hard work in and fail while trying. Only some people are willing ot do that and the people that have done that are clearly living a better life than the people who don't want to risk it by aiming too high and falling short. People should start to set that high standard goal and try to reach for the top because it will benefit them in the future.

Can staying active improve your performance? Thomas Jefferson once said, "Determine never to be idle... it is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing." Always staying active can improve your state of mind and benefit you in multiple ways such as tournaments or exams. Although that might be the true for some, contributing and staying active can also distract the person from life's worst moments.

First, staying active can change a person's state of mind. By making them see a different view point, one can focus more and not have any insecurity's. Many believe staying active can change ones mood and attitude. This can be a great tool for a student that is under a lot of stress over school and school work. Instead of the student staying home and watching television, the student can go for a jog, a hike, or to a gym, overall boosting his mental health. Being in a physical active state can be a get away for some, by being able to relieve and sooth the stress in ones situation. Although, staying physically active can benefit a person's health and state of mind, others might take a different approach and be mentally active. Some go for a run or hike, while others might use up their time to stay home and study or read a novel.

Second, others use the time they have to be productive and contribute to either themselves or others. Many use these two methods as a distraction, to make a person forget or lose track of what might stumble them. On another note, a person in a neighborhood might want to form a neighborhood watch group, to look out and keep his neighborhood safe. Staying active with your community can provide a chain in bravery throughout the community and accomplish a strong bond. Others can use this as inspiration and make something constructive and positive, while also distracting them from other problems and complications that they might be going through. A general misconception is that staying idle or inactive can serve a purpose. To accomplish something, mainly needs activity and productiveness. Some will say it is like a team, with a team you need everyone to contribute and stay active with each other. But if one is not active then he brings no purpose to the team, and does not accomplish anything. Although, people do believe that inactivity can serve a purpose, it cannot out weigh the fact the people that are active can achieve more then someone that is inactive.

To conclude, staying active can most definitely boost your performance in school work or in sports. It can also be used as a distraction, to block and take the mind off of other thoughts the person might be having. There are multiple ways staying active can benefit either yourself or others. It may also increase your self-esteem and mood, your mental health can be tremendously effected in a positive manner. Also, always doing something can be a good habit to have or making a list of chores to do, it helps to mature and organize yourself and your day.

Well, the school board should not add one and a half hour to school each day. For example, my aunt works in the night from five pm to three am, so, my cousin only gets to see her in the afternoon for two hours, or sometimes less. Imagine how my cousin, and the students that have the same issue, would feel if they add time to school, and they have less hours to spend with his/her family. They would probably feel sad , and they can even get depress, so is important for the school board not to to add time to school.

So, the Health Department looking at the results said, that its a bad idea to add time to school because it will only be harmful to students. Another fact about why adding time to school will not help students get better grades is, because a lot of students get headaches when the're in school, and it makes it hard to concentrate. So, imagine how bad the headaches, and the grades will be if they add time to school, all grades are going to go low.

In conclusion, adding time to school will only affect students in many ways, some of them are, students have other activities ,and the time that they use to do them will be taking away, they also have chores to do, finally, it will take away the time that is spend with family, and that time, is a precious time.

Essay:
Summer is the time for students to take a break from school, but some educators feel that summer break is too long and it needs to be shorten. As for me, I am strongly disagree with this idea because summer is the time for student to visit their famiy, their relatives, to do whatever they like, to enjoy whatever they love and sometimes learning too much might be somthing that some students could not handle.

First of all, summer is the time for students to come back to their hometown to visit their family. Some students, like me, came from another country so a lot of times we do miss our hometown. That is why having a three month summer break is truly a huge chance for us because that is pretty much the only reunion we have in a year. I will take mine as an example. To be able to come back to Generic_City it is not just about time, sometimes it could involve money. The ticket is just too expensive, not to mention that it is in summer. So if I can visit my family this year, I might have to wait a few years later to be able to visit them again.

Secondly, this is a period of time where students can do whatever thay want to do like doing some volunteering or club activities or playing sports or just simply doing their favorite hobbies. If we shorten the summer break, students will easily get bored when they come back to school because they do not have enough time to do what they like in summer. Nobody wants to study when they are bored. So if we want a student to return to school with lots of energy, we need to let them have a break. And that give me an example. One of my Vietnamese friend told me that even in summer he still have to take a lot of tutor classes. That is why if we shorten the summer break then lots and lots of Asian students will not even have time to do what they love!

Last but not least, learning too much might be something that some students could not handle. A short summer break meaning we have to go to school more than we need. I know that if we shorten the summer break we will have a longer winter break, but that is not the case for the country that does not have a winter break or a week off in fall and spring. A student could get stress if they do not have a proper break. Just check some examples on the news or internet, especially in South Korea or Japan. A lot of students suicide just because of learning too much. Too many homeworks and tests, pressures from parents and teacher,.... Very stressful! Not to mention that Asian students usually have a shorter summer break and winter break.

On the whole, I am not agree with this idea and along with fact that I am an Asian and I used to go through a very strict and tough education in Asia, I can never accept this. Students need to have some times to release their stress after a long year at school by visiting their family or doing whatever they like.

Essay:
People should get appreciated in whatever they are going to do, because everything comes from hard work. Students are of no exception. True self- esteem and self- confidence comes form within, and in order to do that one must work hard, and should never give up. Students get true self confidence by working hard, paying attention in class, and giving their best shot during test's or exam's. Once something is achieved, students are going to work even more harder and will try to get even better scores on their test's.

Firstly, when a student tries his/ her best during a test and get's a good score they are going to feel motivated to try their best on the next one. My elder sister Generic_Name, felt the need to work harder when she worked hard and got an 85 on her math quiz. My best friend Generic_Name, got more self confident about herself when she was had passed her SAT examination. My elder brother Generic_Name, did not ever stop believing in himself when he passed his 10th Grade SOL's.

Secondly, students never stop believing in themselves once they achieve something. My friend Generic_Name, worked extra hard for the oral exam; when she got to know that she had passed the written exam. My brother Generic_Name, felt confident about taking the English SOL, because he had passed the sample test that his teacher had given him.

Thirdly, students challenge themselves to take harder courses next year. When students work hard and their hard work has paid off by them getting good scores, they feel they should now challenge themselves by taking so hard advance courses to see how they perform on that. My cousin got an A in her Math college prep class, and now she feels that she is supposed to take an AP Course since, College Prep is easy and wants to take an advanced course. My best friend PROPER_NAME, got the self confidence in him and he felt that he should take something that is really challenging for him to do.

Although, some people say that self- esteem does not really help a person and that they should praise a person in order to achieve something, I feel that true achievement comes by believing in yourself and feeling the need to do better.

I do agree on the fact that appreciating a student's work is going to make them feel better and they are going to work hard, because they are getting support form other people; however, a person needs to have faith in themselves and love what they are doing and that's when the feeling of true pride erupts. No matter how much a person puts in their effort for doing something, it is not going to look or seem as good as something that is done from the bottom of our hearts. Therefore, I conclude that students are supposed to achieve something that is going to give them that self- esteem and self- confidence, so they feel good about what they are doing.

Having year-round breaks might be good to get recharged once in a while, but a short break would not create any productivity.

In many student's life, there is a set goal of succeeding in school in order to open doors in the future. Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. Finally, seeking multiple opinions can help someone make a better choice by allowing someone to feel secure with

choices. For instant, if someone gets confuse. If you're lost on one subject. Also, if someone gets lonely. if someone doesn't have a baseball team. Lastly, if someone gets worried or afraid. If someone you know is absent or gone. Seeking multiple opinions can help someone make a better choice.

In summary, viewing many opinions can benefit people to make a better choice by preventing making poor choices or decisions, determining which advice is accurate, and by allowing someone to feel secure with choices. essay:
Technology allows people to complete many tasks without having contact with others. People are eligible to check out books, purchase items online, and play games without having to speak to each other. The limitation of human contact has a negative effect on people's lives due to the use of technology. The use of technology has impacted negatively on those who have a hard time speaking in person. Due to the fact that they aren't have an actual conversation.

However, not everyone agrees with this position. Some people claim that technology is a positive effect on their lives. Since it provides a great use for communicating with each other faster, and an excellent source for those who are willing to keep in touch with friends and family that aren't in the area. Nevertheless, the opportunity overlooks an important point, namely that, people are too distracted by being in the use of technology by texting, watching videos for entertainment, rather than spending time with friends. They end up missing a great chance to spend time with friends, by having to spend all of their time on an electronic device. For an example, if there were to be a family reunion event, and everyone is spending most of their time on their phones, then there is no meaning to the reunion because no one will have the full attention of one another.

Based on this argument one must conclude that technology is a negative effect on people lives.

I really prefer working in groups than by myself, and these are my points of view about why I prefer to work in groups:

Working in groups makes easier to work on an specific project.

We all know that at the moment to work in one specific project, it could be kind of difficult if we do not have enough time to do some parts of the project as soon as possible. But it is more difficult if we try to do it by ourselves.

essay:
Technology has made our world drastically different than ever expected. New technological breakthroughs are happening everyday to help make our society ,and daily lives, simpler. While technology is wonderful, it causes an enormous amount of problems for humans altogether. With a society that is so prone to technology, we as people, are slowly becoming socially inept, incapable of completing simple tasks on our own, and even becoming more and more lazy, and inactive, everyday. These effects of technology are not something the world should look past and forget.

With the rise of technology everyday, people are always using it to communicate with one another. Cellphones, for example, help us to text ,and or, call our friends and loved ones when ever we please; however, we as a society have grown too attached to this concept. Especially in teenagers, technology is stunting the growth of teenage social skills. I have struggled with this myself; with the constant use of my phone, I struggle with encounters with, not only other teenagers, but with adults too. It has become a drastic problem in our daily lives, and is making our connections to other people weaker as a result. People may say that technology helps them stay close and connected, but in reality, it is pulling us farther apart.

Shopping online is something that has always made life easier. Everything that we need can be brought to us with the click of a button which, in some cases, is needed, but as a society; we have become too reliant on everything being too easy for us. Technology has made our lives to simple and does not allow humans to improve on any of their life skills. People struggle with many things in life that span from going to the store to even at their own work place. This is very dangerous for younger generations of children and teens who are still growing up. Hundreds of parents give their kids technology instead of, teaching life lessons, experiences, and giving them goals to complete; therefore, not allowing the children to gain the basic needs of life.

Playing games on a phone or other device is a good way to pass time or to just entertain ones self; however, people today are using them way to frequently. Laziness has plagued or society due to the constant use of technology; whether it is an adult, teen, or child, technology has made us nonproductive in our daily lives. This is a serious matter on all fronts; we live in a world where being active is critical to ones health and well being. People are now preferring to stay inside their homes and do nothing, instead of, going out and doing something productive with their lives. This stunts their health and growth as a human being all together.

Technology has changed our world in ways no one could have imagined, but with all the negative effects present because of it, it is hard to ignore the all the downsides to it. With people now losing social skills, the ability to do simple tasks, and even having the ability, and motivation, to get up and do something productive, it makes it clear that technology could be changing us for the worst. Hopefully as time goes by, we as humans find a better way to restrict ourselves from so much technology use so we can have a brighter future as a society.

My parents and I were happy because we knew that we have time to make some fun things, and we stopped worrying about school, work and study. After the break we were ready and exhausted to start our routine again. Having a break between activities help us to give time to restart our minds.

Secondly, Humans are able to accomplish great goals, but time is required. When I was in middle school, my teacher always gave us time to relax and stop what we were doing at the classroom. According to my teacher, inactivity provides us energy and it is a way to going to be able to continue classwork or activities at school.

Practicing this activity was helpful to me, because I could concentrate even more on my activities at school. Additionally, when my classmates were tired, they ask the teacher for a break because they need that time to clear their minds from worries and stress.

about work in order to recharge our minds and become successful.

Finally, stress can lead you to depression. It is hard to imagine how hard life can be. By concentrating even more on your required activities than fun activities, here it comes its negative side. Some people might quit their goals by not having time for themselves. For example; when my big brother went to college, he needed money to pay college and utensils. Being nice to people can also change the way they think. This topic is really important to me since I have heard many cases from people that are really close to me and that have been through a rough time and told me that little things such as a smile, or a hug, or even helping someone with something that is difficult for them can change the way they feel, the way their day is going, and also the way they think.

Essay:
School prepare students to plunge into a real life and high school is the last step before it. Some people suppose that children of high school are ready enough to select class that help them to choose their future job while another think they are too young to take the right decisions about their future. But if students do not be able to take their own decisions now, when they will do it. Students should have to commit to specific career at a young age because they learn to be more responsible, they have possibility to acquire basics knowledge of their future career and they don't need to accumulate information that they don't need for job that they want to do.

Admission in high school offer new possibility and large choice of subjects for young students. Give them a chance to choose their courses for a career is the first step to help them to know the sense of responsibility. Indeed, when we are child, our parents take the most decisions about our schooling therefore we not be used to take big decisions about us. So, starting to take a decisions like, which career we want to do and which course we like or not, is a beginning of

responsibility. Moreover, left to students opportunity to choose for themselves permit to do and to assume their choices when they make a mistakes and build their confidence when they take a good decision. In addition, if students do some courses for specific career, they can know if they have aptitudes and requirement to do this job later. In fact, sometimes we dream to do career in art for example, but we cannot because do not have enough of skill and thanks to the courses in high school, we can find another.

Taking a decision earlier about our future career allow to acquire more information about it. With a possibility to pick in high school courses that can guide them for his future, students study more to succeed an realize their dream. For example, when one person has passion for something no matter his age, he will give maximum even if

it is complicated because he likes it. Next, having these subjects in high school allow students to make their own research. The desire to discover and learn more push students to be more active, curious and devoted to study for the reason that they want to know.

Some societies esteem that students are too young to decide for their future. For that High schools impose to students more general education. In this way, they have a better general knowledge and set of choices when they are in university. It is true that in high school, many students do not have any idea of what they want to do in their life; nevertheless, to force students to do courses that they find boring and irritating do not help them to find their vocation; on the contrary, they accumulate the information without knowing why. In addition, Among these students, we have another part who know what they want for their future. Unfortunately, with this type of education, more they move forward and less they acquire aptitudes to do what they want. For example, I did all my schooling in a country that privileges general education. In spite of I know what I want to be later, I did not really have a course that help me to understand my future career. But when I came in United States, I was surprised that I can choose which class I want to do or not and quite sincerely, I prefer this because now I have keys of my future in my hand.

To conclude, the age of the students does not be a reason to refuse them to have access of informations about different careers on the contrary, left students to commit to a career help them to learn to be more responsible, to have possibility to acquire basics knowledge of their future career and to avoid them to accumulate information that they don't need for what they want to do.

In conclusion, I think that Duke Ellington is right because problems can help you by making your brain grow up, giving you knowledge, and making your personality stronger. So if you are in a problem you should take the lead of this situation and be determined in solving it, is not the end of the world only because you have a problem, and now you know that problems can help you.

Problems make your brain to grow up, imagine being on a math test and you don't know the answer, probably you will be scared but if you try hard to remember what is the answer you will find it, usually problems are too hard to solve and this fact helps you to make your brain to think a way to solve the problems, this can cause your brain to grow up by using all your energy to think in what you can do in this situation.

Problems gives you knowledge, there should be a reason for you to be in a problem, if you fight in the school or anywhere with another person or you do something bad, probably someone will call you to the office or take you to the police department , if you are in a problem the first thing you will do is think on why this happened and this helps you because you will know what you did bad and will not do it again.

Problems makes your personality stronger, if you crash your car you may feel bad and scared for this event, I had a test that it was hard and in that moment I felt bad, so most of the time when you have a problem you will feel stressed, this stress can be bad for your brain but it can also help you to be more patient and determined in your goal that is solving your problem, with this two things your personality will be stronger that before the problem.

In conclusion, I think that Duke Ellington is right because problems can help you by making your brain grow up, giving you knowledge, and making your personality stronger. So if you are in a problem you should take the lead of this situation and be determined in solving it, is not the end of the world only because you have a problem, and now you know that problems can help you.

You should select me to visit your company. You should select me because I am a very hard worker, I enjoy learning about new things that interest me, and I am willing to step outside my comfort zone. I think all of these traits are great for a intern. I would also learn and takeaway a lot from you guys. I am a very hard worker so if you consider choosing me I will do whatever it takes to be invited and I will show a lot of determination if I were to get some type of internship. An example of my hard work is last year when we were getting ready for SOL's I wasnt the smartest kid in the class but, because I studied so hard I got the second highest score. I also enjoy learning about new things that I find interesting; Like last year when we were choosing classes I decided to take auto tech which is a academy class where you take a bus to Generic_School and go to their garage and learn to work on cars. I chose to this class because I was interested in cars and working with them so instead of taking a normal class I picked auto tech. So because I enjoy learning new things if I were to get some type of internship it would never feel like a job thus leading me to put in more effort.And I am willing to step out of my comfort zone, for example this year I decided to take dual enrollment which is a class gives you a high school and college credit its a harder class but it saves you time and money in the future. This shows I am willing to step outside of my comfort zone because I have yet to take a higher level English class so its not something I am use to. I think that this is the best trait to have as a high school being in a internship because you are meeting new people and you will be in a very unfamiliar setting so I think I am prepared for that.So even thought I am not the smartest kid with all A's I am a hard worker, I enjoy learning about new things that I am interested in, and I am willing to step outside of my comfort zone. I don't think every high school student has these traits so I think I would be the perfect person to start working with you guys.

A lot of people ask for an advice, but others ask more then one person for an advice. An advice means talking to someone for a recommendation. Some people ask one person for an advice. Other people talk to different people. Talking to one person can help, but asking more than one person can help you understand something better. If i am about to do something that i can get in a big trouble for should ask my parents or other adults for an advice.

I would ask different people for an advice, because i can understand something i could do better. Another good thing about asking for an advice is that if i go to like prison for murder, drugs or alcohol, in the future when i go look for a job nobody will want to hire me because of the stuff i did. If i am going to do something really bad in school i should think about consequences that will be and ask someone or more people if it is going to be worth of doing. When i am having trouble doing something or understanding something i should ask others a advice of whats a good way or doing it.

I think that other people should really ask for a advice. If someone wants to do something bad that they can get in trouble or

they can ask for an advice. Is someone wants to make new friends they can ask something for an advice to tell them how they can talk to new people. If i am having bad grades i can talk to my teacher to tell me how i can get

my grades up. And that is why i think an advice means.

Essay:
Is attending classes from home by way online of videoconferencing a favorable method for students to study?

Attending to classes from home by way online or videoconferencing is not a highly recommended way to study, because students will not have the same learning that they have while they are at school. If attending classes from home becomes a common way to study, students will not have the opportunity to build strong friendships with the other students around them, nor with the teachers. Also is not a recommended way to learn because students may not take their courses serious as they do in school because of the instructions of their teachers, or the advice of the counselors, or administrators of school.

In the first place attending classes from home is not the same has being is school, because at school students take their homework, quizzes and exams more serious that they

can do at home. When students are in class and they have any question about the topic that they are learning of the can freely ask their teacher and the teacher will give them a clear explained answer and examples in order for students to understand everything they are teaching them. In addition, if students attend to classes online they will not have the opportunity to stay after school for extra help, or to retake a quiz or exam, nor to attend to a learning center to have other students helping them with their homework; or to just study with the company of another student. As a matter of fact, student's grades will decay due to not having all their questions answered, and their problems being solved.

Secondly, if attending classes online becomes a common way to study, students will not practice their communication skills by not building relationships with their classmates, not discussing their concerns with their classmates, nor just having fun with their friends during lunch ship. They would not feel the same way because at school sometimes students get inspired by other students, they see other students not just as their classmates but also as their friends, they could even see each other as family, therefore, students with the time get to see the school as another home where they know they have people that could help them with school stuff, but also can give them personal advice, as counselors and teachers do. Moreover, when students are receiving classes online at home, they will feel bored, and also lonely because they will not have anyone to discuss their questions or doubts with. In addition, in our present a large percent of teenagers are dealing with psychological problems such as; stress, anxiety, and depression; being at school distracts teens from their problems at home or even at their jobs, and it is a great way to receive help and advice from people willing to help them; such as school counselors, teachers, and friends. Being in school is better rather than being at home alone just studying.

Lastly, attending classes online is not the best idea for students who tempt to not take their studies seriously. While they are at home they wont feel the presence of a teacher standing next to them telling them to get their work done, or asking them to pay attention, and to not fell asleep during class. Also they will not feel the obligation to do their homework, in order to turn it in the following day. When students have to work in groups they learn lots of things from the teammates that they did not before, is a awesome way to inspire each other, and also to have fun, as students see other students work hard for their goals they do it too; but if these students are working alone they do the complete opposite. Therefore, this kind of students will think that they can do what they want and they wont take their courses in the serious way they have to be taken.

In conclusion, attending to classes online is not a favorable way for students to learn because they will not learn the same way that they do while in school. The students will not work on their communication skills, nor their social skills. In addition, students will not take their courses with the grade of seriousness they have to be taken.

Is attending classes from home by way online of videoconferencing a favorable method for students to study?

can do at home. In addition, if students attend to classes online they will not have the opportunity to stay after school for extra help, or to retake a quiz or exam, nor to attend to a learning center to have other students helping them with their homework; or to just study with the company of another student. As a matter of fact, student's grades will decay due to not having all their questions answered, and their problems being solved.

Secondly, if attending classes online becomes a common way to study, students will not practice their communication skills by not building relationships with their classmates, not discussing their concerns with their classmates, nor just having fun with their friends during lunch ship. Moreover, when students are receiving classes online at home, they will feel bored, and also lonely because they will not have anyone to discuss their questions or doubts with. In addition, in our present a large percent of teenagers are dealing with psychological problems such as; stress, anxiety, and depression; being at school distracts teens from their problems at home or even at their jobs, and it is a great way to receive help and advice from people willing to help them; such as school counselors, teachers, and friends. Being in school is better rather than being at home alone just studying.

Lastly, attending classes online is not the best idea for students who tempt to not take their studies seriously. While they are at home they wont feel the presence of a teacher standing next to them telling them to get their work done, or asking them to pay attention, and to not fell asleep during class. Also they will not feel the obligation to do their homework, in order to turn it in the following day. When students have to work in groups they learn lots of things from the teammates that they did not before, is a awesome way to inspire each other, and also to have fun, as students see other students work hard for their goals they do it too; but if these students are working alone they do the complete opposite. Therefore, this kind of students will think that they can do what they want and they wont take their courses in the serious way they have to be taken.

In conclusion, attending to classes online is not a favorable way for students to learn because they will not learn the same way that they do while in school. We accomplish more when we get on our feet because we become successful and if not we become lazy.

First of all, to become successful we have to work hard to reach our goal. One reason is because if we get more things done we don't have to worry about what we have done and what we haven't done. We have to constantly be on top of things, so we can be on top. Another reason is that, everyone excuse is that they have tried and tried but they keep failing, so they stopped. Not everyone is like this, some say it gives them more strength, for example, a 17 year old girl was trying to find something she likes to make a career out of it, but no matter how many job applications she applied to and websites she went, there was nothing. Until one day, she saw a sign that she was interested in and went for it. As a result, never giving up is the key to accomplishing a goal. This proves that even when life is tough, life also comes with many surprises.

Secondly, doing nothing gets us nowhere, but become lazy. One reason being lazy is a huge problem. For example, a classmate was suppose to clean the house before invited their friends over, but because she didn't clean the house it smelled like dirty dogs and there was consequences such as, phone taken, friends not coming over again, and grounded. As a result, laziness will make things worse for us and it would also be very embarrassing. Another reason is if we do nothing, life gets complicated, messy, and impossible. For example, a child grew up spoiled and had everything given to them while they lay in bed relaxing enjoying their life. One day the child grew up and had to live on their own and had a family. When it came for them to get a job they couldn't get any job that they wanted because they had no experience and being spoiled got them expressing greediness and anger, so they stopped trying and went back to doing what they do best. As a result, the child didn't get anywhere in life. We can end up with them same situation and not doing good or we do something about it like experiencing new things to get to the next level in our lives.

To sum it all up, when we do something to accomplish something. Think of it as another step. Essay:
Is technology a positive or negative effect on human life? Technology is a negative effect on all human life because it is a limitation on communication. With technology there is no talking to others, so you become socially awkward. You would not be able to talk infront of a crowd and you do not go out to meet new people.

People become socially awkward by not having the practice to communicate with others. You can not spend the rest of your life shopping online hiding from people. People who do not socialize hide their face when speaking, they can not even order food without getting shy. It is sad how the world is relaying on technology to do everything for them. Something that is amazing is having someone to talk to in person. You would be able to see their emotions and feel their energy when you are talking to them. People are not their just to listen but to also give advice to you. I do not think technology does the same. It does not ask how was your day or how are you feeling because it is not human it is a robot.

When you do not talk to enough people in your life you start to become shy. You will start to realize that in almost every job you need to talk in front of a crowd of people. Even if you can not do that you will have to because that is part of your job just to communicate. That is why in school they start to teach you at a very young age how to communicate. Teachers asign presentations for the students to get comfortable talking to others. Practice is the best way to handle talking to others because talking through the phone and in real life are two different things. When talking on the phone you do not need to see the person you are talking to or you can even just hang up. But in real life you have to learn how to start a conversation with someone and keep the conversation going.

People do not go out to find new friends. Yes, it is awkward going up to someone and saying, do you want to be friends. But that is where it all starts by making one friend you have achived a lot because now you have a friend that you can talk to and not feel alone. You can not stay at home just being online. You should ask your friend do you want to go watch a movie or go eat. That is better then staying at home a playing games all by yourself. Yes, you can talk with your friends and play games at the same time but it is also important to change things up a little bit. Just once in a while find something else to do rather than sitting at home. You can do a sport. You communicate a lot when playing a sport. Being at home you are just surounded but technology and you would never really get away from it if you do not try. Another thing: making friends on socail media is not the same as in person. There might even be a chance you never meet the person you met online or might not even be the person you thought they would be in person.

In conclusion even though technology is a great way to communicate with others that are long distance. It is still important to communicate face to face. Even if it is just for a couple of minutes you should still have someone to talk to. So that later on in your life if you get a job that involves you talking to a crowd you would not be scared. Also going out once in a while is not bad. You should not just stay at home playing games with your friends asked them do you want to go for a walk then you could talk to them in person. It is always a good thing to stay away from technology just somethings. There are other things that you can do even alone. You can read a book, sketch and color, or even just have a nice relaxing walk just to think. Technology should not stop you from having a good life and communicating with others. Just remember technology to some people is everything but to you it should not be.

essay:
Studies show that giving students holiday breaks monthly is a distraction from their classes. Once the start the holiday routine starts, getting a break from all the heavy-load classes will be the only thing in a teenagers mind. Some people argue that there should be year-round schools, but this path only leads to students losing their strict work habits and motives for better grades. Therefore, a long summer break helps students to relax and recharge for couple months before they start the new year stronger and motivated.

Summer is a good opportunity to develop themselves both in school and out of school. American school system provides students an opportunity of summer school. Most students take this chance to raise their grades, while others retake failed classes. Summer school is one of the options to keep your mind fresh and updated. On the other hand, there are plenty of job opennings in summer. People who would like to use the time they have productively can apply for a job to make some extra buck. Applying for a job gives real-life experience, and it can benefit on the persons future interests. Eventhough the job you applied for is not your dream job, it will make a difference on your CV such as work experience. As a result, long breaks could be beneficial, and it is completely up to the person to use the time wisely or to waste it.

Furthermore, apart from some set classes students pick their own classes and each year they get to have a new timetable. They do not learn the same things they learnt a year ago, but it adds information to a persons background knowledge. As an example, in maths students learn a different curriculum each year to expand their knowledge rather than concentrating in one area. Besides after a year long of hard-work and dedication they earn a one long break. High schools are too tight with deadlines and tests that students never get a chance to do something other than school-work. Most juniors and seniors did not had the chance to get a driving license or to participate in any social responsibilty activities in the past few years. Which means if they did not have the summer break to catch up on these activities, it would be impossible to do it in the academic year. Having year-round breaks might be good to get recharged once in a while, but a short break would not create any productivity.

United States is twenty-seventh in the world for it's academics, meaning people are not productive in their holiday breaks. Countries like Great Britain and Finland are using the same system, but they are in top three in the world. Critics say that schooling system is not working. However, having breaks monthly will be a distraction and students will lose more focus. In conclusion, system is not failing students are, and to change that: they must change the habits of the lifestyle they live with.

There are many reasons behind school should not be year around. Students deserve to distract their minds off classes for a period. This will lead to motivation, temptation, and determination. Students will come back stronger, with bigger goals ahead of them.
